Version 1.1.0 helps switches keep working when Hue resources or the bridge change, and makes grouping lights easier.

## What's new

- When a switch would use two or more individual lights, its dialog offers a matching room or zone, or to create a zone for those lights. A room or zone switches its lights with one command and includes lights added to it later in the Hue app.
- When a light, room or zone is renamed in the Hue app, sonoff2hue follows it and saves its new name in the switch. If a target is missing, the switch keeps toggling the others and *Repairs* explains what is missing; other switches are unaffected.
- After the Hue bridge has been unreachable for a minute, sonoff2hue looks for it at a new address. With a pinned certificate, it saves the address and reconnects. Without a pin, *Repairs* explains how to pair the bridge at the new address.

## Fixes

- Additional LAN queries help keep a switch *Online* when it misses a broadcast.
- When *Test toggle* fails, its notification shows the specific error instead of a generic failure message.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/abpostelnicu/sonoff2hue-homeassistant/compare/v1.0.0...v1.1.0
